generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can certify a transport representation whose bytes are intact while a downstream schema-aware validator expects the materialized logical object.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Hash and certify a transport wrapper as though it were the semantic JSON object consumed by the next gate.

reusable_control.rule: Materialize supported transport before semantic validation and reject unsupported legacy transport at schema-aware boundaries.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Use a single artifact reader that verifies transport and returns logical bytes before schema-aware hashing and validation.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Readiness and certificate gates must validate the logical semantic object and require all independent-rejection ledger artifacts before release.

transfer_cases.expected: supported transport materializes; unsupported legacy wrapper is rejected by semantic validation
physical shards are verified and logical JSON is validated before certification

skill_changes.target: handoff readiness and certificate logical artifact validation
